services.value: Provides full-service water treatment and water management programs including cooling tower water treatment/compliance, boiler water treatment, drinking water services, and legionella sampling/testing with in-house ELAP certified laboratory testing. Also offers mechanical & HVAC services (boilers/HVAC repairs and installations), licensed electrical installation & construction (including EV charging station infrastructure), installation & construction, and remediation/secondary disinfection for building water systems.
